id.description: globally unique; duplicates are deduped no-ops

kind.description: blocked/unblocked/completed/heartbeat get special semantics; others render as generic activity

task_id.description: stable work ref; drives decision open/close

actor_kind.description: inferred from actor prefix when absent

payload.description: source-specific. Convention: reason = decision-card text (blocked); kind = needs_input | diagnostic | null (severity). No type constraints here — payloads vary by source.
